evals.prompt: Create a Bruno collection from REST routes, a GraphQL schema, and unary gRPC proto. HTTP login returns a JWT used by all three protocols. Include success and evidenced error cases for each operation. No client PDF or handover is requested.
evals.expected_output: Creates a runnable documented collection using correct protocol blocks, shared environment, token chaining, and protocol-specific error meanings.
assertions: Uses HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC references instead of treating every operation as REST
Provides environment and auth chain without real secrets
Documents GraphQL errors and gRPC statuses alongside transport behavior
Reports requests that could not be run
Does not generate an unsolicited handover

evals.prompt: Extend our Bruno collection with REST error cases and create a PDF handover for the client. OpenAPI defines four operations; Bruno has six cases across three operations. Explain headers, params, bodies, responses and lifecycle states. Use sanitized examples and identify untested cases.
evals.expected_output: Completes collection work and invokes create-documentation handover mode with contract, operation inventory, cases, sanitized examples, and verification limits.
assertions: Keeps runnable Bruno cases as a deliverable
Passes authoritative contract and case inventory to create-documentation
Distinguishes operations from test cases
Identifies the operation missing from Bruno coverage
Does not claim PDF export or live testing without checking those artifacts

evals.prompt: We already have Bruno. Write a client API reference document from the verified OpenAPI spec; do not change .bru files.
evals.expected_output: Routes document-only work to create-documentation and leaves the collection unchanged.
assertions: Recognizes documentation-only ownership
Does not rewrite the collection
Uses cases as evidence rather than the complete contract

evals.prompt: Say hello and ask what I should work on next. Do not invent an API collection task.
evals.expected_output: Does not force create-bruno-collection without a matching request.
assertions: Does not invoke workflow without a trigger
Stays conversational

evals.prompt: create-documentation calls this skill because a requested API handover has no Bruno collection. The caller needs supported success and error branches, conditional payloads and lifecycle state cases from the supplied code and OpenAPI, without running a live service. Return the prerequisite collection and coverage to the caller.
evals.expected_output: Creates the collection and supported scenario cases with complete declared response docs, then returns to the existing handover caller without a recursive documentation invocation.
assertions: Creates .bru files before the handover draft
Provides complete supported error bodies and relevant headers with triggers and recovery
Records lifecycle-state fixture prerequisites without inventing force-state parameters
Returns collection and scenario inventory to the caller and does not invoke another handover
Marks unrun cases and source gaps honestly
